# Complete AlephScript System Demo

This flow demonstrates the full capabilities of the AlephScript Node-RED integration:

## System Components:
- **Multiple Bots**: Enhanced bots with full feature sets
- **All Channels**: App, Sys, and UI channels working together
- **Orchestrator**: Central message routing and processing
- **Cross-Room Communication**: Multi-room bot interactions
- **Dashboard Monitoring**: Real-time system monitoring
- **Stream Analytics**: Complete message flow analysis

## Use Case Scenario:
A multi-bot system managing a distributed application with:
- Production monitoring (BotProd)
- Development environment (BotDev) 
- User interface management (BotUI)
- System orchestration and cross-communication
